propositions: Hand-rolled CLI argument parsing loops in claim.py and transition.py must be replaced with argparse without changing observable behavior or help output.

The --force flag has command-specific semantics that must be preserved: claim bare --force consumes next non-option token else uses default reason, transition bare --force sets force_reason='' (not None) and never consumes following tokens.
The --assignee flag must preserve None-vs-empty-string sentinel semantics: absent argument falls back to default_assignee, explicit empty string clears assignee, value-less usage exits with code 1.
The transition._parse_flags function must be retained as an argparse-backed shim returning the identical 5-tuple to preserve three external direct callers in test and script files.

Unknown/extra tokens must be silently skipped, --help must remain dispatcher-served from golden files (not argparse-generated), prefix abbreviations must be disabled, and retired --force-close must continue rejecting with code 1.
